LESSON: PARABLE OF THE LOST COIN

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ:
Topic 3.8.1: Parable of the lost coin

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Parable of the lost coin
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How does God show love for the sinner?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. retell the parable of the lost coin
2. recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life
3. appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: retell the parable of the lost coin
• Model 2: recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life
• Model 3: appreciate God’s love and lead upright lives

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: retell the parable of the lost coin
2. Practise: recognise God’s love for the sinner and the need to live a righteous life
